in_sanskrit.name: दुर्वा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Durva is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘durvā’, which means difficult or hard to reach. It is believed that the name was given to children who were born after a long and difficult pregnancy, or to those who had to overcome significant challenges in their lives.

in_hindi.name: दुर्वा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Durva is also used in Hindi, where it is spelled as ‘दुर्वा’. Its meaning in Hindi is ‘satisfied’ or ‘content’. The name is believed to bring happiness and contentment to the one who bears it.

in_marathi.name: Durva
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Durga's footprint
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durva हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Durva is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘durvā’, which means the footprint of the goddess Durga. This name is also associated with the Durva grass, which is considered sacred in Hinduism and is used during rituals and pujas. Durva is believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and protection.
